resources.string: A floating button that wakes Circle to Search.
Enable the Accessibility service to show the floating button over other apps.
Choose which side of the screen the button starts on. You can still drag it vertically.
Test whether the direct Circle to Search trigger works on this device.
Circle to Search trigger failed. Assistant fallback may open instead.

This app sends a direct trigger to the system voice-interaction service. The included LSPosed module must be enabled for Circle to Search to open. If the trigger fails, the app can open the Assistant instead.
Shows a floating button that can wake Circle to Search or the system Assistant.
